about_the_game:
※ In this demo version, you can experience the early part of the game, a few mini-games, and basic interactions with NPCs.
More jobs, endings, areas, and deeper NPC storylines will be added in the full version.
This demo offers a taste of the game’s atmosphere and systems — feedback is always welcome!

After a sudden business failure and a mountain of debt, you've lost everything and return to your hometown to start from scratch.
You’ll have to survive day by day, take on small jobs, build your skills, and reconnect with the community to find new opportunities.
But reality isn’t kind.
Under pressure from debt collectors and limited resources, your choices will determine your future.
Can you rise again through hardship and reclaim your life?

Begin your journey of survival and redemption now.

Game Features

Realistic Survival & Economic Management

  • Start with low-paying jobs to make ends meet. Manage your time and money carefully to climb toward a better life.

  • Balancing living expenses and loan repayments becomes a constant challenge that demands strategy and sacrifice.

Stat Growth and Skill Progression

  • Develop attributes like Strength, Intelligence, Agility, and Perception to unlock new job opportunities and interactions.

  • Train through mini-games, hard work, or study — tailor your growth to your play style.

NPC Interactions and Relationships

  • Build meaningful relationships with the people of your hometown.

  • Gain rewards or help by deepening bonds, and discover each NPC’s unique story.

Grounded Life Simulation Elements

  • Manage fatigue, health, and emotional well-being to maintain a balanced life.

  • Recover or enhance these stats through work, rest, or hobbies.

Immersive Mini-Games

  • Engage in interactive mini-games during job tasks and events to earn bonuses and enjoy a more hands-on gameplay experience.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GPU GeForce GTX 750 Ti
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 9 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 64-bit operating system is required
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10(64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 64-bit operating system is required

short_description: You've lost everything and returned to your hometown, forced to start over to survive. This city is filled with both opportunities and dangers. Can you carve out a new life in this unforgiving environment?
supported_languages: English, Korean, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Spanish - Latin America, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil
